Style: dark fantasy character concept sheet in a polished Unreal Engine 3D-rendered look. The image is a game character design board for a cute chibi female character blending cat and bat traits, wearing a sensual gothic dress, with English character-introduction typography. The background is a charcoal-to-black textured gradient with smoky vignetting, warm rim light, and bronze-brown serif lettering. On the left side, a large heading reads "CHARACTER INTRODUCTION", followed by the name "LILITH" and the subtitle "THE NIGHT WHISPERER". Beneath it, the body copy is set as stacked uppercase lines reading "A CURIOUS AND PLAYFUL", "FELINE-BAT HYBRID.", "SHE MOVES THROUGH THE", "NIGHT LIKE A SHADOW,", "WHISPERING SECRETS", "AND LEAVING ONLY", "MEMORY BEHIND." Lower on the same panel, smaller labels read "SPECIES:", "FELINE-BAT HYBRID", "ROLE:", "EXPLORER / SCOUT", "WEAPON:", "CURSED DAGGER", "AFFILIATION:", and "THE LOST CLAN". To the right of this text block, the main full-body character stands in a confident three-quarter pose: petite, doll-like, fair-skinned, with oversized amber-brown eyes, soft blush, pointed feline ears, black tousled hair, and small horn-like accents. She has bat wings spread behind her, a long curled tail, clawed feet, and wears a black-and-burgundy gothic outfit with lace, straps, gold chains, bows, thigh-high stockings, and high-heeled boots. In the upper-right area, a circular emblem shows a stylized bat silhouette inside a crescent moon, surrounded by thorn-like branches and small stars. Below that, a vertical stat panel titled "ABILITIES" lists four entries with matching icons: "BAT GLIDE" with "USE WINGS TO GLEAM", "HIDDEN IN SHADOW" with "BECOME HIDDEN IN DARKNESS", "FELINE REFLEX" with "ENHANCED AGILITY AND SPEED", and "CURSED BLADE" with "DEAL DAMAGE AND APPLY CURSE". Along the bottom center, a framed inset portrait repeats the character close-up against a warm interior setting, while the lower-right inset shows the character crouched in shadow with wings and dagger visible. The whole composition uses cinematic low-key lighting, warm highlights, realistic 3D materials, ornate fantasy UI borders, and a cohesive black, burgundy, bronze, and amber palette.
